subject: OpenBMB provider-family, selected provider projections and provider-neutral pattern contracts

hardware_decision.reference_host: Dell Precision Tower 7910 with 2x E5-2696 v4, 44 physical cores, 88 logical CPUs and two NUMA domains is evidence, not a portable default
hardware_decision.reference_accelerator_expectation: RTX 3080 12GB compute role and current NVIDIA/CUDA stack must be rediscovered, never assumed
hardware_decision.cpmcu: BLOCKED until target-native current-host CUDA ABI and SM build, correctness, quality, benchmark and rollback evidence pass
hardware_decision.minicpm_o: No default full-duplex activation until VRAM/QoS/privacy/quality evidence passes
hardware_decision.forgetrain_forgestencil: Datacenter-GPU upstream results are pattern evidence only and cannot promote the T7910

license_decision: Code, model-weight, dataset and output-use rights remain separate gates; PilotDeck and StaffDeck AGPL sources are pattern-only and shall not be vendored by this materialization.
model_artifact_decision: Provider records do not admit model weights. Exact model revision, hashes, license acceptance and runtime compatibility are required through the canonical Model Manager before activation.
